description: Gives every step its own output, placed immediately to the right of a Basic Sequencer, Binary Sequencer, Dual 8 Step Sequencer, 8 Step Trigger Sequencer or Gated Comparator

params.text: Picks TRIGGER, where an output is high only while the clock pulse is high, or GATE, where it stays high for the whole of the step

outputs.text: Goes to 10V while the sequencer is on that step, lasting the whole step or only the clock pulse according to the TRIGGER/GATE switch

notes: the CHANNEL light shows which channel of the sequencer this module follows, in the colour of that channel's knobs; the direction, length and current step all come from that channel
more expanders can be chained by placing each one immediately to the right of the last, in any combination and any order; each expander in the chain adds one sample of delay
